extracted.intended_audience: patent researchers, historians, and legal professionals (users of USPTO patent indexes)
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index (United States Patent Office, 1878) listing inventions and associated metadata — patentee, patent number, issuance date, monthly volume, and Official Gazette reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention or discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: The title or short designation of the patented invention (e.g., 'Lamp', 'Lantern', 'Lathe', etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries are grouped and presented alphabetically by the invention name; multi-word forms and variants (e.g., 'Lamp-chimney', 'Lamp-wick') appear as separate indexed headings. Use the inventor's chosen short title or the office's subject heading as the indexed invention label.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name of patentee
rubrics_metrics.description: Full name(s) of the patent holder(s) or patentee(s) associated with the invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows individual inventors and joint inventors in the order printed (examples: 'E. J. Blackham', 'W. E. Sawyer and A. Man', 'J. H. Irwin and E. L. Bill'). Include multiple names exactly as given to preserve attribution and order.

rubrics_metrics.name: No.
rubrics_metrics.description: The official patent number assigned to the granted patent (column labelled 'No.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numerical patent identifier is provided for each entry (examples: '202, 321', '209, 425', '199, 584'). Record the number exactly as printed (including commas) for cross-referencing with patent records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.description: The date of patent issue/publication associated with the patent number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dates are provided in month/day/year format where printed (examples: 'Apr. 16, 1878', 'Oct. 29, 1878', 'Jan. 15, 1878'). Use the issued date to place the patent chronologically and to resolve priority or timeline queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly volume
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to the monthly volume number of the Official Gazette or the Patent Office monthly in which the patent appears.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Column labelled 'Monthly volume' gives the volume/page grouping for the patent's publication; use it to locate the patent notice in periodical volumes (examples: numerical volume identifiers shown in the index entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference code or pagination for the Official Gazette where the patent notice appeared.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 'Official Gazette' column supplies cross-reference information for finding the patent announcement in the Official Gazette (examples visible throughout the index). Record these references to facilitate retrieval from the Gazette.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: The index is organized alphabetically by invention/subject heading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This determines the primary sort order for the list (the page shows contiguous headings under 'Lamp', 'Lantern', 'Lathe', etc.). Use alphabetical ordering rules consistent with the index when constructing or searching similar lists.
